summary: Picked kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline at random from the rotation repos (avoiding last week's feed-quality-gate pick). Idea: scripts/demo.py, an offline demo of the margin/alert pipeline needing no Docker, Postgres, Airflow, secrets, or the private astk package -- it seeds 5 synthetic products, simulates competitor prices, runs the real src.margin_engine + src.alert_manager.format_alert_message, and prints a table (plus optional --json). Wrote the goal/success-check file before any code, built it with 11 tests, opened PR #27, and had a fresh Opus subagent independently verify all 6 success checks by actually running them (including import-blocking astk/psycopg2/docker/airflow to confirm no hidden dependency) -- VERIFIED, no failures. CI went green and the PR merged.
